title: consent-substrate: Signed Authorization and Witness Boundaries for LLM Agents
description: Reference implementation of the consent-substrate stack: an Ed25519-signed rules-of-engagement gate (deny-by-default, fail-closed, hash-chained audit) and an injection-canary substrate (seeded tokens, decoy paths, decoy endpoints) sharing one trust root, yielding a detected-or-proven guarantee against quiet-class compromise of LLM agents. Companion software for the paper 'Detected or Proven: Signed Witness Boundaries Against Quiet-Class Compromise of LLM Agents'.
